title: E0042: Impossible Assertion
plain_english: Reports assertions that can never hold on any feasible path.
why_matters: An assertion that is always false indicates contradictory logic, an incorrect assumption, or a bug in the surrounding control flow. This rule uses Phanalist's bounded formal verification engine (Z3-backed) to detect provably impossible assertions.
what_it_checks: Assertions whose condition is unsatisfiable on every feasible path
Assertions narrowed by earlier branches, `isset()`, and short-circuit conditions
Unknown assertion conditions are treated as assumptions, not failures
